description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search the submission history of payment statements such as daily-worker and simplified payment statements, including whether submitted and the year-month. Use sbms_ym_strt/sbms_ym_end (YYYYMM). For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

mate_knd_cd.description: 자료종류코드(document type) - 비우면 그 달 제출분 전체: A0161=일용근로소득 간이지급명세서, A0162=연말정산 간이지급명세서, F0025=사업장제공자 등 과세자료 제출명세서, F0026=일용근로소득 지급명세서. Optional.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
